info.title: Google Docs MCP REST API
info.description: REST API for reading Google Docs and managing comments. For use with ChatGPT Custom Actions.

post.summary: Read a Google Document
post.description: Reads the content of a Google Document. Returns plain text by default.

documentId.description: The ID of the Google Document (from the URL)

format.description: Output format: 'text' for plain text, 'json' for raw structure

maxLength.description: Maximum character limit for output. Omit for full content.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID to read a specific tab

format.description: The format of the returned content

content.description: The document content (string for text format, object for json format)

length.description: Length of the content in characters (for text format)

400.description: Bad request - missing documentId

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

get.summary: List comment threads in a document
get.description: Returns every comment thread with its anchored range, status, assignee and replies. Runs on the Docs API: `id` is a Docs commentId, and IDs cached from the older Drive-backed response will not resolve.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: The ID of the Google Document

post.summary: Add a comment anchored to a text range
post.description: Adds a comment ANCHORED to the given range, so Google Docs highlights that text in the document body. endIndex must be greater than startIndex. Optional assigneeEmail assigns the thread, and creation is the ONLY time a thread can be assigned - Google refuses to add an assignee to a thread created without one.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: The ID of the Google Document

startIndex.description: The starting index of the text range (inclusive, 1-based)

endIndex.description: The ending index of the text range (exclusive)

commentText.description: The comment text, as plain text. Maximum 2048 UTF-8 bytes; a longer body is refused before the call.

assigneeEmail.description: Assign the new thread to this person. Cannot be done later.

tabId.description: Optional tab the range lives in. Defaults to the first tab.

segmentId.description: Optional header/footer/footnote ID. Omit for the document body.

id.description: The Docs commentId of the new thread.

confirmed.description: Google's commentUpdateState verdict. false means the write was NOT acknowledged - re-read before relying on it. A state of ALL_FAILED_UNKNOWN_REASON is returned as an error instead, with nothing written.

commentUpdateState.description: Google's raw verdict: ALL_SAVED, NO_UPDATES_REQUESTED, or absent.

400.description: Invalid request body

post.summary: Create a doc from text, HTML or markdown content
post.description: Uploads the content and lets Drive convert it into a Google Doc. The body limit on this path is 5mb, because the content is the whole document. Not idempotent: each call creates another doc.

content.description: The document content, in the source format named by mimeType.

mimeType.description: The SOURCE format Drive converts from, not the result.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Convert a .docx already in Drive into a Google Doc
post.description: Copies the file with the Google Docs mimeType so Drive converts it. Takes a Drive file ID, not file bytes. Anything whose mimeType is not .docx is refused with 400, because Drive would convert it into an unreadable document.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Append text to the end of a doc or tab
post.description: Resolves the end index itself, so no index is needed. The body limit on this path is 5mb. The response reports the index used and whether a newline was prepended.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID. Defaults to the first tab.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Insert text at a 1-based index
post.description: Indices shift as the document changes. For several edits at once use batchUpdate, which orders them so they do not invalidate each other.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID. Defaults to the first tab.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Apply up to 50 document operations in one batch
post.description: Index-based operations are applied in descending index order so they do not shift each other. Mixing global replacements (replace_text, find_replace) with index-based operations is refused with 400 rather than reordered, since no ordering preserves the caller intent. Includes delete_text, so this endpoint can remove content.

operations.description: Each operation needs a `type` plus that type fields. Types: insert_text, delete_text, replace_text, format_text, update_paragraph_style, insert_table, insert_page_break, find_replace, create_bullet_list.

suggestMode.description: If true the whole batch is applied as tracked SUGGESTIONS for a human to accept or reject, and the document itself is unchanged until someone does.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Replace every occurrence of a string
post.description: The response reports occurrencesChanged, which is 0 when nothing matched — a successful call, not an error.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID. Defaults to the first tab.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Delete a character range
post.description: DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible through this API. A POST to an action path rather than a DELETE on the range, so the call site reads as deliberate. endIndex must be greater than startIndex: a zero-width range is a no-op the API would accept, which would read as a successful delete.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID. Defaults to the first tab.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Apply character formatting to a range or found text
post.description: The response reports the range that was resolved, which matters when the target was given as text to find. `applied: false` with `fields: null` means no recognised style key was supplied and nothing was written.

target.description: One of: {textToFind, matchInstance}, or {startIndex, endIndex}, or (paragraph only) {indexWithinParagraph}.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Apply paragraph formatting by text, index or range
post.description: A text target is widened to the paragraph containing it, so the resolved range in the response is wider than the text matched. `applied: false` means nothing was written.

target.description: One of: {textToFind, matchInstance}, or {startIndex, endIndex}, or (paragraph only) {indexWithinParagraph}.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Format the Nth instance of a string
post.description: Flat-parameter alternative to text-style, same engine underneath. At least one formatting option must be present or the body is refused.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Insert a table of the given dimensions
post.description: Inserts an empty table at the index.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Insert a page break at an index
post.description: Inserts a page break at the index.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Insert an inline image from a public URL
post.description: Google fetches the URL server-side, so it must be publicly reachable. Width and height are only applied when both are given.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Insert an image from a URL, Drive file, local path or base64
post.description: Exactly one source must be given. Every source except driveFileId UPLOADS a new file to the user Drive and returns its URL, which is a side effect worth knowing about. The base64 path is capped at 20mb decoded, checked from the string length before any buffer is allocated; the body limit on this path is 5mb.

driveFileId.description: An image already in Drive. Made publicly readable so Google can fetch it.

fileName.description: Required with imageBase64, for MIME detection.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Export a doc to PDF and save it to Drive
post.description: An export that MUTATES: the PDF is written to Drive and the new file is returned. Anything that is not a Google Doc is refused with 400.

pdfFilename.description: Without extension. Defaults to the document title.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Reply to a comment
post.description: Adds a reply to the comment thread. `confirmed` is Google's own commentUpdateState verdict: false means the reply was not acknowledged, not that it failed.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Mark a comment resolved
post.description: Resolving is a reply carrying commentAction RESOLVE - the Docs API has no thread-status field - so an optional replyText is posted as the closing note. `resolved` reports Google's verdict: a state of ALL_FAILED_UNKNOWN_REASON comes back as an error with nothing written, and anything short of ALL_SAVED answers confirmed false rather than claiming success. Reversible with the reopen endpoint.

replyText.description: Optional closing note posted with the resolution. Maximum 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

confirmed.description: Google's commentUpdateState verdict. false means the write was NOT acknowledged - re-read before relying on it. A state of ALL_FAILED_UNKNOWN_REASON is returned as an error instead, with nothing written.

commentUpdateState.description: Google's raw verdict: ALL_SAVED, NO_UPDATES_REQUESTED, or absent.

400.description: Invalid request body

post.summary: Delete a comment thread
post.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Deletes the thread and every reply on it; not recoverable. POST to an action path rather than DELETE on the resource. Exposed on this plane with explicit sign-off.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

get.summary: Get one comment thread with its replies
get.description: The Docs API has no per-comment endpoint, so this reads the document and finds the thread. A 404 means no thread in this document carries that id - including a comment ID from the Drive API, which is a different id space.

404.description: No thread with that id in this document

get.summary: List suggested edits on a document
get.description: Returns the document's suggested edits (tracked changes) with their status, summary text and discussion.

post.summary: Reopen a resolved comment thread
post.description: The inverse of resolve, also posted as a reply action (commentAction REOPEN).

replyText.description: Optional note posted alongside the action. Maximum 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

confirmed.description: Google's commentUpdateState verdict. false means the write was NOT acknowledged - re-read before relying on it. A state of ALL_FAILED_UNKNOWN_REASON is returned as an error instead, with nothing written.

commentUpdateState.description: Google's raw verdict: ALL_SAVED, NO_UPDATES_REQUESTED, or absent.

400.description: Invalid request body

post.summary: Reassign a comment thread
post.description: REASSIGNMENT ONLY. Google answers 400 when the thread was created without an assignee, and an unassigned thread can never be assigned - create it with POST /comments and assigneeEmail instead. The 400 is rewritten to list every documented cause, because Google's response names none of them.

assigneeEmail.description: The person to assign the thread to.

replyText.description: Optional note posted alongside the action. Maximum 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

confirmed.description: Google's commentUpdateState verdict. false means the write was NOT acknowledged - re-read before relying on it. A state of ALL_FAILED_UNKNOWN_REASON is returned as an error instead, with nothing written.

commentUpdateState.description: Google's raw verdict: ALL_SAVED, NO_UPDATES_REQUESTED, or absent.

400.description: Invalid request body

post.summary: Rewrite the text of a comment or reply
post.description: DESTRUCTIVE in effect: it overwrites the post's text and the previous version cannot be read back through any API. Only the original author may update a post. Exposed on this plane with explicit sign-off.

parameters.name: postId
parameters.description: The ID of the post - the comment itself or one of its replies.

content.description: The replacement text, as plain text. Maximum 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

confirmed.description: Google's commentUpdateState verdict. false means the write was NOT acknowledged - re-read before relying on it. A state of ALL_FAILED_UNKNOWN_REASON is returned as an error instead, with nothing written.

commentUpdateState.description: Google's raw verdict: ALL_SAVED, NO_UPDATES_REQUESTED, or absent.

400.description: Invalid request body

post.summary: Delete one reply from a comment thread
post.description: DESTRUCTIVE and not recoverable. Narrower than the thread delete: the thread survives and one reply is removed. Exposed on this plane with explicit sign-off.

parameters.name: postId
parameters.description: The ID of the post - the comment itself or one of its replies.

confirmed.description: Google's commentUpdateState verdict. false means the write was NOT acknowledged - re-read before relying on it. A state of ALL_FAILED_UNKNOWN_REASON is returned as an error instead, with nothing written.

commentUpdateState.description: Google's raw verdict: ALL_SAVED, NO_UPDATES_REQUESTED, or absent.

400.description: Invalid request body

post.summary: Reply to a suggestion thread
post.description: Posts a reply on a suggested edit rather than on a comment thread. A separate path from the comment reply because a request naming both a comment and a suggestion thread is refused.

replyText.description: The reply text. Maximum 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

confirmed.description: Google's commentUpdateState verdict. false means the write was NOT acknowledged - re-read before relying on it. A state of ALL_FAILED_UNKNOWN_REASON is returned as an error instead, with nothing written.

commentUpdateState.description: Google's raw verdict: ALL_SAVED, NO_UPDATES_REQUESTED, or absent.

400.description: Invalid request body

post.summary: Accept a suggested edit
post.description: Applies the suggested change to the document. `confirmed` comes from the acceptedSuggestionIds Google reports back, so a request that touched nothing is not reported as applied. Rejecting and deleting a suggestion are deliberately NOT on this plane: both discard proposed text irrecoverably and neither has REST sign-off - use the MCP tools, where the destructive annotation is visible to the client.

reportedIds.description: The ids Google said it accepted. Null when it reported none, which is unconfirmed rather than failed.

400.description: Invalid request body

bearerAuth.description: API key obtained from the registration dashboard

quotedText.description: Google's plain-text record of the anchored text, captured when the comment was created.

author.description: Display name of the comment author

resolved.description: Whether the comment has been resolved

anchorId.description: The anchor this thread is tied to. Several threads may share one anchor.

ranges.description: The highlighted range(s). EMPTY when the anchor could not be resolved, which is not the same as the thread being unanchored - check anchorId.

assigneeEmail.description: Only set if the thread was created with an assignee.

Comment.description: A comment thread. Backed by the Docs API, so `id` is a Docs commentId - comment IDs from the Drive API are a different id space and do not resolve against these endpoints.

author.description: Display name of the reply author

postId.description: The Docs API name for this identifier. `id` carries the same value.

action.description: RESOLVE or REOPEN when the reply was an action rather than a message.

deleted.description: A deleted post keeps its id and loses its content and author.

Range.description: A range in the document a comment is anchored to.

segmentId.description: Header, footer or footnote ID. Null or empty means the document body.

author.description: Display name, or Anonymous. Google sends no email address for a post author.

Suggestion.description: A suggested edit (tracked change) and its discussion.

summaryText.description: Plain-text summary of the proposed change. May be empty.
